note: Settled by IMPL v0.18 §1.6: escaping counts equal brackets since the last inserted backslash, so line 3's '<<<<' renders as '<<\<<', and reversal is one pass over the escaped text. First quote: the model escaped twice, writing '<<\\<'; one pass gives '<<\<', not in the file: CIT-004. Second quote, '<<\<\<': the first backslash follows two brackets and is removed; the second follows one counted bracket and stays, giving '<<<\<', not in the file: CIT-004.
